entries.title: Hebrews 3:1
segments: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, [even] Jesus;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:2
segments: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:3
segments: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:4
segments: For every house is builded by some one; but he that built all things is God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:5
segments: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:6
segments: but Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we hold fast our boldness and the glorying of our hope firm unto the end.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:7
segments: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:8
segments: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:9
segments: Where your fathers tried [me] by proving [me,] And saw my works forty years.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:10
segments: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:11
segments: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:12
segments: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:

entries.title: Hebrews 3:13
segments: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:

entries.title: Hebrews 3:14
segments: for we are become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm unto the end:

entries.title: Hebrews 3:15
segments: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:16
segments: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:17
segments: And with whom was he displeased forty years? was it not with them that sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:18
segments: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that were disobedient?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:19
segments: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
